To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Ustroń lineup — request for reconsideration

Marek, I am asking you to reconsider Liliana’s placement as reserve before the names are submitted on Friday, 13 November. I do not agree that the November rating list alone provides a sufficient basis for this decision.

In your message of 1 October, you stated that selection would take account of both the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October, and that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the lineup was finalised. I was not consulted about Liliana, and I would like my assessment and her qualifier result to be considered before submission.

Liliana finished second in that qualifier with 5.5/7, ahead of Maja on 4.5/7 and Igor and Antoni on 4/7. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Although a rapid qualifier is not the same as a rating list, it was explicitly included in the announced criteria and should carry meaningful weight.

The November list places Igor at 1874 and Liliana at 1851. However, Liliana’s 81-point loss came entirely from the Katowice event. Health reasons affected her participation there, although she completed all her games, and subsequently caused her to miss approximately two weeks of training in October. In my assessment, that result does not reflect her current playing strength. She is now back to her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good.

This is not a criticism of Igor, whom I respect as a player. My concern is that we apply the announced criteria consistently and include the promised coaching input.

My request is to place Liliana on board 2. Alternatively, I would accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, with the format and selection implications agreed beforehand. Please confirm before the submission deadline how we will resolve this and review the lineup.
